mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% within the past month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting the Federal Reserve to adopt a more accommodative stance, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an imminent recession, which typically triggers a sharp decline in equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decline >= 0.5% and UNRATE rise >= 0.2% over the prior 30 days
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% and UNRATE rises by at least 0.2% over the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST has increased by at least 1.0% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 200,000 jobs signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS exceeds 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market downturn (HOUST < 1500.0 thousand units), the S&P 500 tends to decline due to reduced consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST falls below 1500.0 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decline >= 0.5% and HOUST decline >= 0.5% over the prior 30 days
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS declines by at least 0.5% and HOUST declines by at least 0.5% over the prior 30 days.
